g.text: PR #2479 · Keep socket database waits off the async worker threads
A frame waiting on the DB pool used to freeze a whole tokio worker (of 2).
Now run_blocking hands that worker's other tasks off, so sockets keep moving.
BEFORE
handle_agent_output, inline
db_pool.get() waits up to 30 s on a full pool.
The tokio worker running it can do nothing else.
2 vCPUs = 2 workers
Two waiting frames stall every socket.
Heartbeats stop; liveness evicts agents after 60 s.
Launcher registration
Held a connection across .await sends.
Could not be wrapped as one blocking unit.
AFTER
websocket::run_blocking(work)
block_in_place on the multi-thread runtime.
Frame order and borrowed state are kept.
Proxy, browser and launcher dispatch
Each frame's DB work runs inside run_blocking.
Test: other task < 300 ms while one blocks 600 ms.
LauncherAuth (blocking check)
Then the same five acks, sent async.
Same text, fatal flags and reject reasons.
Sockets only: HTTP handlers still call app_state.conn() inline (follow-up). Does not resize the pool or fix the memory spike.
